# Generated synthetic example

These Acme IDs and records are generated by `tools/make_fixtures.py`.

```powershell
python "$SkillDir/scripts/export_history.py" plan --exporter "$Exporter" --credential-ref env:DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN --run-id synthetic-demo --guild-id 700000000000000001
```

After reviewing that scope, replace `plan` with `execute`. The environment variable is set locally; its value is never part of this command. `$SkillDir` is the installed skill directory and `$Exporter` is an existing DiscordChatExporter CLI executable.
